content.value_statement: Tamagui projects can suffer from inconsistent tokens, slow components, and inaccessible patterns. This skill gives practical v1 guidance for config, compiler optimization, forms, overlays, animations, and themes.
actual_capabilities: Explains Tamagui config v4 setup with styleCompat and package import guidance.
Provides compiler-safe patterns for styled components, variants, prop order, and styleable wrappers.
Documents form, dialog, sheet, popover, tooltip, and select patterns with accessibility notes.
Summarizes animation drivers, transition patterns, enterStyle, exitStyle, and cross-platform caveats.
Gives design token and theme guidance for palettes, fonts, spacing, and responsive values.
Points to current Tamagui docs URLs for optional manual reference checks.
limitations: Covers Tamagui v1.x patterns and may not reflect future breaking changes.
Provides guidance and examples but does not execute tests or inspect a project automatically.
Assumes projects already use React, React Native, Expo, or compatible Tamagui tooling.
External documentation checks require network access and user approval in restricted environments.

use_cases.title: Start a Tamagui Project
use_cases.description: Set up config v4, core tokens, compiler options, and import choices before building shared components.

use_cases.title: Refactor Component Patterns
use_cases.description: Replace brittle inline styles with styled variants, token props, and wrapper patterns that preserve overrides.

use_cases.title: Standardize Design Tokens
use_cases.description: Create consistent palettes, typography, spacing, themes, and responsive values for a cross-platform design system.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Tamagui project setup for config v4, package imports, and basic token usage. Point out missing or risky choices.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Tamagui component and suggest changes that improve compiler flattening, prop override behavior, and token consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Check Forms and Overlays
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my Tamagui form, dialog, sheet, and select patterns for accessibility, validation, mobile adaptation, and state handling.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Scalable System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Tamagui v1 design system plan for themes, palettes, fonts, variants, animations, and compiler-safe component architecture.

output_examples.input: Review a slow Tamagui card component with many dynamic style props.
output_examples.output: Explains that dynamic style props can block compiler flattening, recommends variants, checks prop order, and lists accessibility checks.

output_examples.input: Plan a select control that works on web and touch devices.
output_examples.output: Suggests Tamagui Select with Adapt and Sheet for touch, plus labels, error text, and z-index guidance.

output_examples.input: Create theme guidance for a cross-platform product interface.
output_examples.output: Returns palette, token, font, spacing, and responsive recommendations aligned with Tamagui config v4.

best_practices: Read the focused reference file before changing forms, overlays, animations, compiler behavior, or design tokens.
Prefer styled variants and Tamagui tokens over dynamic inline styles for reusable components.
Use Adapt, labels, validation libraries, and explicit state handling for accessible forms and overlays.
anti_patterns: Mixing React Native StyleSheet values with Tamagui tokens.
Branching on Platform.OS for dialogs or sheets instead of using Adapt.
Creating untyped variants or spread order that prevents caller overrides.

faq.question: Which Tamagui version does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Tamagui v1.x patterns, including config v4 guidance and related compiler behavior.

faq.question: Can it write complete components?
faq.answer: Yes, it can guide component structure and examples, but project tests should still verify behavior.

faq.question: Does it cover accessibility?
faq.answer: Yes, it includes label matching, dialog behavior, overlay adaptation, validation, and error state guidance.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No. Network access is only needed if you choose to fetch current Tamagui documentation.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What projects benefit most?
faq.answer: React, React Native, Expo, and web projects that use Tamagui for shared cross-platform UI benefit most.
